title: When the Signal Wakes
author: Yara Brightwater
blurb: Lena Winterbourne, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
